stories.title: Reform MS says British Empire was “force for good” in Senedd clash with culture minister
stories.summary: The British Empire was declared a “force for good” by a Reform MS during questions to Wales’ culture minister. Caerdydd Penarth MS Joe Martin clashed with Heledd Fychan after questioning the Welsh Government’s plans to promote Welsh heritage and culture. stories.summary: Flintshire County Council’s chief executive has written to Transport for Wales asking for new signage at stations on the Wrexham to Bidston line, after Tap and Go ticket machines were found to charge full adult fares regardless of age or Railcard status.
